  "tools": [
    {"name": "agenttrail", "url": "https://github.com/sodiumsun/agenttrail"}
  ],
  "on_screen_text": "GitHub - sodiumsun/agenttrail | github.com/sodiumsun/agenttrail | view all files | README | MIT license | A | agenttrail | Know what your coding agents are doing, while they are doing it. | npm | MIT | coverage 100% | GitHub Stars 480 | Your coding agent has been working for half an hour. Is it making progress? Is it stuck? Did it quietly reopen the part it already called done? | agenttrail is a local, open-source observability layer for AI coding agents. It turns plans, tool calls, file changes, and progress from Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or any agent that edits files into a live project map. | Start an agent, walk away, and come back to this: | agenttrail | Planning | Active | Ship to GitHub and sync | Editing src/api/client.ts | Running | cd your-repo | npx agenttrail | The browser opens on the live board. On a repo with no plan it offers the full setup inline — one y/n, and the backfill prompt lands on your clipboard. Hooks are auto-wired with your consent. After a restart...",
  "key_claims": [
    "AgentTrail is a local map that shows what AI coding agents are actually doing while they work",
    "Users can start a task, walk away, and return to a live dashboard",
    "The dashboard displays the agent's plan, current tool calls, and which files are being touched in real time",
    "It runs entirely on the user's machine with no cloud servers or accounts required, making it completely private",
    "It connects what the agent claims it is doing to the code it is actually editing",
    "It flags/lights up finished tasks if they need another pass",
    "It supports Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or any agent that edits files",
    "Setup is done via a simple command (npx agenttrail) in a repo",
    "It has 480 GitHub stars and is open-source under MIT license"
  ],
  "info_channel": "on-screen"
}
```
